title: Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease Wear Forgiveness Waiver and Its Posting Tool
content:
**Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease — the wear forgiveness waiver at lease end**

**Rule.** A wear forgiveness waiver can be recorded only while the lease status is returned or early terminated, only against the excess wear charge billed for the turn-in, and only once for that charge. It is booked as one waiver with waiver reason wear forgiveness that names the excess wear charge and carries the qualifying account number the wear forgiveness rule names for it, or none. When wear forgiveness figures to zero, no waiver is booked.

**Scope.** For the wear forgiveness waiver of a turn-in, and only for that waiver, the amount waived is figured under the wear forgiveness rule; the excess wear charge itself, the disposition fee and its loyalty waiver remain under the end-of-term charges rule.

**Business effect.** The waiver appears on the lease's posting history as a lease-end charge waiver linked to the excess wear charge it forgives, and the lease's end-of-term balance falls by the amount waived. The lessee sees the forgiveness as a credit on the lease-end account and a smaller balance owed.

| Lease status | Excess wear charge billed for the turn-in | Wear forgiveness waiver already booked on that charge | Waiver may be recorded |
|---|---|---|---|
| Returned or early terminated | yes | no | yes, when wear forgiveness figures above zero |
| Returned or early terminated | yes | yes | no — once per charge |
| Returned or early terminated | no | — | no — there is no charge to forgive |
| Active, maturity extended, purchased, closed or other | — | — | no |

---

**Posting tool: `post_wear_forgiveness_925a15e3`**

*Capability.* Records one wear forgiveness waiver against the excess wear charge billed when a Kestrel closed-end lease ended: one waiver entry on the lease's posting history with waiver reason `wear_forgiveness`, linked to the excess wear charge it forgives, lowering the lease's end-of-term balance by the amount waived.

*How it is invoked.* This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `post_wear_forgiveness_925a15e3` and then calls it.

*Parameters*

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | the customer reference number of the lessee, as the customer profile lookup returns it | identifier |
| `lease_contract_id` | the reference number of the lease record whose end-of-term account receives the waiver, as the lease lookup returns it | identifier |
| `waived_txn_id` | the reference number of the excess wear charge entry being forgiven, as the lease posting history lookup returns it | identifier |
| `amount` | the forgiveness amount in USD | positive number with 2 decimal places, rounded to the cent |
| `qualifying_account_number` | the qualifying account number the wear forgiveness rule names for this waiver, copied character for character from that contract's account number as the contract lookup returns it | verbatim text, or an empty string when the rule names none |

*Return.* A receipt with `waiver_id` (reference number of the new waiver entry), `customer_id`, `lease_contract_id`, `waived_txn_id`, `amount` (USD forgiven, 2 decimal places), `waiver_reason` (always `wear_forgiveness`), `end_of_term_balance` (USD left owed on the lease-end account net of this waiver, 2 decimal places) and `status` (`posted` when the waiver is on the account).

*Illustration of the call shape (placeholders only)*: `customer_id` = the lessee's reference, `lease_contract_id` = the lease reference, `waived_txn_id` = the excess wear charge entry, `amount` = the figured forgiveness to the cent, `qualifying_account_number` = the named account number or an empty string; the receipt returns `status` `posted` and the end-of-term balance after the waiver.
